column1: # Ash Jenna's two fights: the optional super boss in Vale and the one at Suhalla Gate.

column3: Isaac. I wondered how\nlong you would take\nto come home.{end_wait}
Jenna, stop this.\nI don't want to fight\nyou.{end_wait}
Then you'll die\nwanting to.\nShow me what you've got.{end_wait}
Hm. Still standing.\nThe fire isn't done\nwith you, Isaac.{end_wait}
The soldiers don't\nsay much anymore.\nNeither will you.{end_wait}
Go on, then.\nBut I'll be waiting\nwhere you end up.{end_wait}
